The 'theoretical layers active' metric was also wrong (4/9 → corrected to 6/12 PARTIAL-or-better).

proactive_detections.cost_if_missed: Would have repeated the mislabeling in subsequent docs, demos, and user-facing presentations. A reviewer who looked at base_cases.py would have concluded the diagnosis itself was unreliable.
